Definition: from G2962; mastery, i.e. (concretely and collectively) rulers:--dominion, government.
BiblicalUsage: Dominion here is the order of rulers itself, the ranks of authority in heaven and on earth. Paul says in Ephesians 1:21 that Christ is far above "all principality, and power, and might, and dominion," in Colossians 1:16 thrones and dominions were created by Him and for Him, and in Jude 1:8 and 2 Peter 2:10 the false teachers "despise dominion" and speak evil of dignities.
TheologicalSignificance: To my mind, the ranks exist and Christ is above them all: every dominion was made by Him, and the men who despise authority prove they do not know the One who holds it. Every dominion was made by Him, and every dominion answers to Him.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; Paul; Jude, Brother of James; Simon Peter
